item.title: I Made an App
item.description:
The app I use to time debates was removed from the play store a long time ago, so I have recreated it. This was partly an exercise to teach myself app development but I hope others find it useful. I focused on simplicity, as the existing apps are unnecessarily complicated, I hope the minimalism is appreciated.
